messages.author: e9ab831d77228443
messages.subject: Fitting model using inlabru
parts:
Hi there

I am a new user of inlabru.  I noticed that in the introduction of inlabru, one of its notable advantages is fitting GAMs with non-linear predictors. I am curious if inlabru can handle spatial lag models? i.e. y= (I-\rhoW)^-1 X + e, where e has a particular SAR structure in its variance.  

Looking forward to hearing from you.
Charles LING

Hi,

In addition, you can check this paper too:

Gómez-Rubio, Virgilio, Roger S. Bivand, and Håvard Rue. 2021. "Estimating Spatial Econometrics Models with Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation" Mathematics 9, no. 17: 2044. https://doi.org/10.3390/math9172044

It describes the ’slm’ latent effect and develops some examples.

Best,

Virgilio
